class.name: NetwClockConfig
class.brief_description: Configuration for the clock of [member Node.multiplayer].
class.description: Use [method Netw.configure_clock] to configure the clock. [codeblock] func _init() -> void: Netw.configure_clock(self).tickrate(60).display_offset(2) [/codeblock]

method.name: display_offset_ticks
method.description: The number of ticks the visual display lags behind the simulation, normally used to hide jitter and lag. The interpolation engine has its own techniques to hide jitter and lag. Still, a small display offset is recommended.

method.name: physics_interpolation
method.description: When [code]true[/code], the engine's physics interpolation fraction is used when available instead of a wall-clock estimate.

method.name: sync
method.description: The strategy used to align the local clock with the server, one of [enum NetwMultiplayer.SyncMode].

method.name: ticks_per_second
method.description: How many simulation ticks to run per second. Increasing this value increases the simulation fidelity, but also increases the network traffic and CPU usage.
